lines.en: label christmaskirin1:
: {i}Ahem.{/i}
scene kirinxmad1
: I said...{i}ahem!{/i}
lines.zh: : 我说了……{i}咳哼{/i}！

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Bless you?
lines.zh: : 长命百岁？

lines.en: scene kirinxmad2
: That was a cough, not a sneeze!
lines.zh: : 那是咳嗽，不是打喷嚏！

lines.en: : Do you...want me to ask Touka if she has any NyQuil or something?
lines.zh: : 你要……我去问问 Touka 有没有感冒药什么的？

lines.en: : No, idiot! I want you to apologize to me so we can go back to being normal again and put an end to all this frustrating tension!
lines.zh: : 不是，笨蛋！我要你跟我道歉，这样我们就能恢复正常，结束这种让人憋屈的紧张气氛！

lines.en: : Oh. My bad. Apologize for what, though?
lines.zh: : 哦。我的错。不过，为什么道歉？

lines.en: scene kirinxmad3
: I can’t really remember. Something with my sister, I think.
lines.zh: : 我也记不太清了。大概跟我姐有关吧。

lines.en: : You mean that time I tackled her to the ground and completely ruined my relationship with her? The one that I already informed you about?
lines.zh: : 你是说我把她扑倒在地、彻底毁掉了我跟她之间关系的那次？就是我已经跟你说过的那次？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Probably.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。大概是吧。

lines.en: : Well, what else would it be? Because I-
lines.zh: : 嗯，那还能是什么？因为我——

lines.en: : We can just call it the Karin thing and be done with it. I’m waiting.
lines.zh: : 我们就叫它「Karin 那件事」就行了。我在等。

lines.en: : So...Wait, I still don’t really get what I’m apologizing for. You already know what happened. We even had sex afterward.
lines.zh: : 所以……等等，我还是没搞懂我要为什么道歉。你已经知道发生了什么。我们之后甚至还做了爱。

lines.en: : Yeah. But it wasn’t even, like...{i}that{/i} enjoyable.
lines.zh: : 是啊。可那甚至，怎么说……没{i}那么{/i}爽。

lines.en: : You came like six times.
lines.zh: : 你都高潮了六次了。

lines.en: scene kirinxmad2
: {i}Four!{/i} Now, stop making me yell! It’s embarrassing!
lines.zh: : {i}四次{/i}！行了，别再让我喊出来了！丢死人了！

lines.en: : Kirin, what are you doing?
lines.zh: : Kirin，你到底在干什么？

lines.en: scene kirinxmad4

: I don’t know, okay?! Like, I’m mad at you for some reason! But I don’t fully understand it and I don’t want to go back to normal like nothing happened! But I {i}also{/i} don’t want to stop spending time with you!
lines.zh: : 我不知道，行了吧？！就是，我因为某种原因在生你的气！可我自己也不完全明白，而且我不想当什么都没发生过就恢复原样！但我{i}也{/i}不想不再和你待在一起！

lines.en: : That sounds both extremely complicated and extremely on-par with your character thus far.
lines.zh: : 听起来既极其复杂，又极其符合你到目前为止的人设。

lines.en: : Feeling bad isn’t supposed to be a part of my character! I’m the cool sex-friend! Feelings are for people like Ayane and Noriko! Not me!
lines.zh: : 「难过」本来就不该是我人设的一部分！我是那个酷酷的炮友！感情是 Ayane 和 Noriko 那种人的事！不是我的！

lines.en: : So...what do you want me to do? Take you into some secret room and fuck you back to normal or something?
lines.zh: : 那……你想让我怎么办？把你拖进什么密室，操到你恢复正常之类的？

lines.en: : Yes! But only after you apologize and things go back to normal.
lines.zh: : 对！但得在你道完歉、一切恢复正常之后。

lines.en: : Kirin, {i}you’re{/i} the one making things {i}abnormal{/i} right now. I’m completely fine with going back to the way we were whenever you want. {i}You’re{/i} the one who’s been avoiding me.
lines.zh: : Kirin，现在把事情弄得{i}不正常{/i}的是{i}你{/i}。我随时都乐意回到从前的样子。一直躲着我的人是{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : Why?!
lines.zh: : 为什么？！

lines.en: : Why...are you avoiding me?
lines.zh: : 为什么……躲着我？

lines.en: scene kirinxmad5
: Yeah! Like...why would I do that?
lines.zh: : 对啊！就是……我为什么要那么做？

lines.en: : If I had to take a guess, you’re probably just pissed off at me for what I did to your sister because you secretly love her.
lines.zh: : 要我猜的话，你大概只是因为我对你姐做的事在生我的气，因为你偷偷爱着她。

lines.en: : No. That’s ridiculous. It has to be something else.
lines.zh: : 才不是。太离谱了。肯定是别的原因。

lines.en: : Okay. So you’re totally cool with me fucking her then?
lines.zh: : 好吧。那我操她你完全无所谓咯？

lines.en: scene kirinxmad8
: Don’t even fucking-
lines.zh: : 你他妈别——

lines.en: scene kirinxmad6
: Oh my God. That {i}is{/i} what it is.
lines.zh: : 我的天。还真{i}就是{/i}这么回事。

lines.en: : You really didn’t know that?
lines.zh: : 你真的一直没意识到？

lines.en: : No! I’m not supposed to be like this!
lines.zh: : 没有！我不该是这样的！

lines.en: : Like, yes. I like you now. I have accepted that. It’s a thing. But literally anyone with half a brain would want to bone Karin and it doesn’t make sense for me to be mad if-
lines.zh: : 就是，没错。我现在喜欢你。这点我已经接受了。这是事实。可只要脑子正常的人都会想干 Karin，所以如果——我为此生气根本说不通。

lines.en: : Kirin, you’re not mad because I want to bone Karin. You’re mad because I upset her and you care about her.
lines.zh: : Kirin，你生气不是因为我想干 Karin。你生气是因为我伤了她的心，而你在乎她。

lines.en: scene kirinxmad7
: No, because why would I want you to apologize to {i}me{/i} then?
lines.zh: : 不对，那我为什么还要你跟{i}我{/i}道歉？

lines.en: : You don’t. You’re just dumb.
lines.zh: : 你不需要。你只是笨。

lines.en: scene kirinxmad8
: And {i}you’re{/i} an asshole!
lines.zh: : 而{i}你{/i}是个混蛋！

lines.en: : I sure am.
lines.zh: : 我确实是。

lines.en: : So, are we back to normal yet?
lines.zh: : 那么，我们恢复正常了吗？

lines.en: : If I say yes, can we go talk somewhere more private so everyone isn’t looking at me anymore?
lines.zh: : 如果我说好了，我们能换个没人的地方说话吗？这样大家就不会再盯着我看了。

lines.en: : No one is looking at you. I put up my anti-eavesdropping barrier that I break out whenever I have private conversations in crowded rooms. So there really isn’t any {i}reason{/i} to go somewhere more-
lines.zh: : 没人看你。我架起了我的防窃听结界——每次在拥挤的房间里说私事，我都会把它拿出来用。所以我们真没{i}必要{/i}换到更——

lines.en: scene black
: Shut up! We’re going somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴！我们要换个地方。

lines.en: : Okay, but you’re underestimating how large this place is and we’re totally going to get lost.
lines.zh: : 行吧，不过你低估了这地方有多大，我们绝对会迷路的。

lines.en: scene kirinxmad9
: {i}We’ll be fine. I downloaded the Tsukioka Manor navigation app.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不会有事的。我下载了 Tsukioka 宅邸的导航 app。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Oh, right. That’s a thing. I’m telling you though, we really don’t need to-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦，对。是有这么个东西。不过我跟你讲，我们真的不需要——{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You don’t have some kind of forcefield, Sensei! Now, give me your hand!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你可没有什么力场，Sensei！好了，把手给我！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}We’re holding hands too?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我们还要牵手？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}No! I’m simply pulling you along!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不是！我只是在拽着你走！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}With interlaced fingers? Is that really necessary?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}手指还要交缠？真有这个必要吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It’s so you can’t get away!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这样你就跑不掉了！{/i}

lines.en: : ...what do you think about that, Chika?
lines.zh: : ……你怎么看，Chika？

lines.en: scene kirinxmad10
: I think that doesn’t look like “love” at all.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那看起来一点都不像「爱」。

lines.en: : We were talking about Secret Santa. {i}What{/i} doesn’t look like-
lines.zh: : 我们在说神秘圣诞老人的事。{i}什么{/i}看起来不像——

lines.en: scene black
: Tick tock.
lines.zh: : 滴答，滴答。

lines.en: scene kirinxmad11
Kirin drags me through Tsukioka Manor until we reach an area almost entirely devoid of life, save the straggling butler and occasional maid.
lines.zh: Kirin 拽着我穿过 Tsukioka 宅邸，直到我们来到一个几乎完全没有人气的区域，只剩零星落单的管家和偶尔路过的女仆。

lines.en: It seems the entire place is decorated for Christmas, though. So it’s hard finding a space to remind her that we don’t live in a beautiful, happy world where everything can always go the way we want.
lines.zh: 不过整座宅子似乎都为圣诞节装饰过了。所以很难找到一个地方，来提醒她：我们并不生活在一个一切都能如我们所愿的美好幸福的世界里。

lines.en: It’s something the two of us know, sure. But it’s also something we delude ourselves into thinking isn’t the case at times because escapism comes easier than accepting that.
lines.zh: 这一点我们两个当然都清楚。可我们也时不时会自欺欺人地认为事实并非如此，因为逃避总是比接受来得容易。

lines.en: I’ve been fine with being avoided by her. Because, on one hand, my absence in regard to {i}anyone{/i} is nothing short of an improvement.
lines.zh: 她躲着我，我无所谓。因为从一方面说，我对{i}任何人{/i}的缺席都绝对算得上一种改善。

lines.en: But even if she was pained by it, the idea of her being crushed by the weight of her sisterly love or whatever you want to call it seemed even greater. Just in a good way.
lines.zh: 可即便她因此痛苦，一想到她被那份姐妹之爱——或者随便你怎么称呼——的重量压垮，那种感觉反而更强烈。而且是好的意义上的强烈。

lines.en: Of course, that was never meant to last. She can love her sister {i}and{/i} think that she loves me. And I can encourage her or bully her or do whatever it takes to turn her on since it’s different any given day.
lines.zh: 当然，这注定不会长久。她可以爱她的姐姐，{i}同时{/i}以为自己爱我。而我也可以鼓励她、欺负她，或者做任何能让她动情的事——反正每天都在变。

lines.en: We’ll end up on a bed again soon. We’ll tell each other we’re bad people...then kiss or something. And it’ll feel great. But it’ll also feel empty.
lines.zh: 我们很快又会滚到床上。我们会告诉对方我们都是坏人……然后接吻什么的。那感觉会很好。但也会很空虚。

lines.en: It’s kind of like waking up Christmas morning and finding a bunch of presents with nothing in them.
lines.zh: 有点像圣诞节早晨醒来，发现一堆什么都没装的礼物。

lines.en: Box after box of unrealized joy, because it’s never been what’s on the inside that counts. It’s always been the wrapping.
lines.zh: 一盒又一盒未能兑现的快乐，因为重要的从来都不是里面的东西。一直都是包装。

lines.en: She wore a bow for me today.
lines.zh: 她今天为我戴了个蝴蝶结。

lines.en: I can not wait to open her.
lines.zh: 我迫不及待要拆开她。

lines.en: : Do you...really think I love my sister?
lines.zh: : 你……真的觉得我爱我姐吗？

lines.en: : I’d be extremely surprised if you didn’t.
lines.zh: : 如果你不爱，我反倒会非常意外。

lines.en: : Oh? And why is that?
lines.zh: : 哦？为什么？

lines.en: : Because we’re alike.
lines.zh: : 因为我们很像。

lines.en: : We both pretend not to care as much as we actually do. And while I’m sure the reasons for that are different, I can understand the basics like the back of my hand. It just...keeps things easier.
lines.zh: : 我们都装作没有那么在乎，实际上却在乎得多。虽然我确信原因各不相同，但这种基本的套路我熟得像自己的手背。只是……这样事情会轻松些。

lines.en: : I guess it...doesn’t sound like the end of the world when you put it that way.
lines.zh: : 听你这么说……好像也没到世界末日的地步。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : You wouldn’t believe how the end of the world really looks.
lines.zh: : 你不会想知道真正的世界末日长什么样。

lines.en: scene kirinxmad12
: {i}Hah...{/i}I could be talked into believing anything right now with how...all over the place I’ve been lately.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}我现在大概说什么都会信，毕竟我最近……整个人乱七八糟的。

lines.en: : This has been eating at me more than you probably know. And, like...it’s so fucking {i}dumb.{/i} Like, why am {i}I{/i} more hung up on it than {i}she{/i} is?
lines.zh: : 这件事折磨我的程度，恐怕超出你的想象。而且……真的他妈{i}蠢{/i}。为什么{i}我{/i}比{i}她{/i}还放不下？

lines.en: : Because it’s the first time I’ve hurt anyone really close to you.
lines.zh: : 因为这是我第一次伤害跟你真正亲近的人。

lines.en: : You hurt Noriko like every fucking week.
lines.zh: : 你他妈每个星期都在伤 Noriko。

lines.en: : Yeah, but Karin is different. You’ve known her your whole life.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可 Karin 不一样。你认识她一辈子了。

lines.en: : You’ve seen firsthand just how much of a ball of sunshine she is. Faulting you for cursing my solar eclipse of an existence helps nothing or no one at all.
lines.zh: : 你亲眼见过她有多像个阳光球。怪你咒骂我这个日食般的存在，对谁都没有半点帮助。

lines.en: : I’ve always hated the sun.
lines.zh: : 我一直都讨厌太阳。

lines.en: : That’s not true. You thrive during all of our beach trips.
lines.zh: : 才不是。我们每次去海滩你都活力满满。

lines.en: : Only when you’re around. But that’s because I {i}have{/i} to if I want to stand out.
lines.zh: : 只有你在的时候。可那是因为我想出风头就{i}不得不{/i}这样。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how fucking...difficult it is having to compare myself to {i}her{/i} every day, though?
lines.zh: : 可你知道每天都要拿自己跟{i}她{/i}比，有多他妈……难吗？

lines.en: : I want nothing more than to just...be able to fucking {i}hate{/i} her because I have no shortage of reasons to. But she...
lines.zh: : 我最大的愿望就是……能他妈痛痛快快地{i}恨{/i}她，因为我不缺恨她的理由。可她……

lines.en: : Karin puts me before {i}everyone.{/i}
lines.zh: : Karin 永远把我放在{i}所有人{/i}前面。

lines.en: : That has to be why she didn’t tell me. She knows how much you mean to me and she...didn’t want to shatter that image when, like you said, nothing {i}technically{/i} happened.
lines.zh: : 这一定就是她没告诉我的原因。她知道你对我有多重要，而她……不想打碎那个形象——毕竟就像你说的，{i}严格来说{/i}什么都没发生。

lines.en: : Why {i}do{/i} I mean so much to you, Kirin?
lines.zh: : 我{i}为什么{/i}对你这么重要，Kirin？

lines.en: : I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : Is it just because I give you attention?
lines.zh: : 只是因为我给了你关注吗？

lines.en: scene kirinxmad13
: Well, why do you like {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那你为什么喜欢{i}我{/i}？

lines.en: scene kirinxmad14
: If you even...{i}do{/i} like me, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，如果你……{i}真的{/i}喜欢我的话。

lines.en: : Of course I like you.
lines.zh: : 我当然喜欢你。

lines.en: : Well, it’s sure as fuck not because I give {i}you{/i} attention then. You get that from fucking everyone.
lines.zh: : 那肯定不是因为我给了{i}你{/i}关注。你从所有人那儿都能得到关注。

lines.en: : Yet it fixes nothing.
lines.zh: : 可这解决不了任何问题。

lines.en: scene kirinxmad12
: Even if everyone ever starts looking at you, Kirin...
lines.zh: : 就算有一天所有人都开始看你，Kirin……

lines.en: : If you get all the attention you’ve ever dreamed of...If you become that “perfect girl” you see your sister as...
lines.zh: : 就算你得到了梦寐以求的全部关注……就算你变成了你眼中姐姐那样的「完美女孩」……

lines.en: : You’re not going to be any happier. Because that’s when you’ll pivot to not thinking you deserve it.
lines.zh: : 你也不会更快乐。因为到那时，你又会转而觉得自己配不上这些。

lines.en: : So I’m just doomed to fucking hate myself for the rest of my life then?
lines.zh: : 那我这辈子就注定要他妈一直恨自己了？

lines.en: : It’ll get easier to stop hating yourself when you stop trying so hard to be liked.
lines.zh: : 当你不再那么拼命想被人喜欢时，不再恨自己就会容易些。

lines.en: scene kirinxmad15
: Is that what you’re doing then? Just...trying to get people to like you?
lines.zh: : 那你就是在做这个了？只是……想让别人喜欢你？

lines.en: : Or hate me. Depends on the mood I’m in.
lines.zh: : 或者恨我。看我当时的心情。

lines.en: : Seems to always backfire though since I’ve done that with you and {i}you’re{/i} still interested in me for whatever reason you’ve landed on.
lines.zh: : 不过似乎总是适得其反——我对你也是这么做的，可{i}你{/i}还是因为某种你自己想出来的理由对我有兴趣。

lines.en: scene kirinxmad16
: Yeah...
: If almost raping my sister didn’t make me want to leave you behind, I’m worried nothing will.
lines.zh: : 如果差点强奸我姐都没让我想离开你，我怕这世上再没什么能让我离开了。

lines.en: : I’ve never felt that strongly about anyone before. It’s scary.
lines.zh: : 我从来没有对谁有过这么强烈的感觉。这很吓人。

lines.en: : Now imagine you {i}keep{/i} feeling it.
lines.zh: : 现在想象一下，你{i}一直{/i}保持着这种感觉。

lines.en: : And imagine every time you do, there’s something {i}else{/i} that shows up out of nowhere and pulls it away.
lines.zh: : 再想象一下，每当你这样，就会有{i}别的{/i}东西凭空出现，把它夺走。

lines.en: scene kirinxmad17
: So you try to chase after it...even when you know you’ll never catch up. And you’re aware that it would be so much easier to just {i}stop{/i} and...find something similar, but you can’t.
lines.zh: : 于是你试着去追……哪怕你知道自己永远追不上。你也清楚，{i}停下来{/i}……去找个差不多的东西会容易得多，可你做不到。

lines.en: : Until you {i}can.{/i} But then that gets pulled away too.
lines.zh: : 直到你{i}能做到{/i}。可然后那个也被夺走了。

lines.en: : I wish I was you.
lines.zh: : 我真希望我是你。

lines.en: : I wish I could just...{i}not{/i} feel strongly about anyone or {i}anything.{/i} But that’s only because I’ve been beaten down by how it feels to do the opposite to the point where I can barely even breathe nowadays.
lines.zh: : 我真希望自己能……{i}不{/i}对任何人、{i}任何事{/i}抱有强烈的感情。可那只是因为，反过来的感受已经把我打得半死，到如今我几乎连呼吸都困难。

lines.en: scene kirinxmad18
: Woah there, friend! Perhaps it’s time you ease back on all the melodrama? It’s Christmas after all! Today’s not the day to get all sentimental like this. You’re probably boring the poor girl!
lines.zh: : 哇哦，慢点儿，朋友！也许你该少来点这种苦情戏了？毕竟今天是圣诞节！今天可不是这么感伤的日子。你大概要把这可怜的姑娘给无聊死了！

lines.en: : Yeah...you’re probably right.
lines.zh: : 是啊……你大概是对的。

lines.en: : Kirin doesn’t care about what happened to me. She doesn’t care about the steps I took and all of the shit I fell over to get here.
lines.zh: : Kirin 不在乎我经历过什么。她不在乎我走过的每一步，也不在乎我一路跌跌撞撞摔过的所有跟头。

lines.en: : She only cares about how I make {i}her{/i} feel. The rest is just noise.
lines.zh: : 她只在乎我给{i}她{/i}什么感觉。其余的都只是噪音。

lines.en: : I’m a tool, like everything else. One that she can use to make herself grow.
lines.zh: : 我是个工具，跟其他东西一样。一个她可以用来让自己成长的工具。

lines.en: : Now you’re getting it!
lines.zh: : 你这就开窍了！

lines.en: : And one day...many years from now, if we ever manage to get there, I’m sure she’ll look back on all of this as a great learning experience.
lines.zh: : 而有一天……很多年以后，如果我们真能走到那一步，我确信她回望这一切时，会把它当成一次很棒的学习经历。

lines.en: : She’ll regret letting me do what I did to her. She’ll regret feeling this strongly at all. She’ll regret me.
lines.zh: : 她会后悔让我对她做了那些事。她会后悔自己动了这么深的感情。她会后悔认识我。

lines.en: : I just hope she doesn’t have to go through what it’s like to have me plucked from her hands.
lines.zh: : 我只希望她不必经历「我被人从她手里夺走」的那种滋味。

lines.en: : Oh, Akira. How have you fallen so far? Your eyes were so bright when you were young.
lines.zh: : 哦，Akira。你怎么会堕落至此？你小时候的眼睛多明亮啊。

lines.en: : Don’t you remember all the time we spent together? Were {i}we{/i} plucked from your memories as well? Or were we simply casualties of time itself while you moved on and became an adult?
lines.zh: : 你不记得我们一起度过的那些时光了吗？{i}我们{/i}也被从你的记忆里夺走了吗？还是说，我们只是你长大成人、继续前行时被时间本身牺牲掉的产物？

lines.en: : An adult?...
: Is that what you think I am?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我是那种东西？

lines.en: scene kirinxmad19
: I have not grown...a day in my life.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子……一天都没有长大过。

lines.en: : It’s all just a lie I tell myself to sleep better at night.
lines.zh: : 这一切都只是我为了晚上能睡得好一点而对自己撒的谎。

lines.en: : But when even my lying doesn’t help put me to sleep anymore, what’s there left to do?
lines.zh: : 可当连撒谎都没法让我入睡的时候，还剩什么可做？

lines.en: : Stop...
lines.zh: : 别说了……

lines.en: : Stop what? I-
lines.zh: : 别说什么？我——

lines.en: scene kirinxmad20
: Sorry, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Kirin。

lines.en: : I’m seeing things today.
lines.zh: : 我今天出现幻觉了。

lines.en: : Well, whatever you’re seeing isn’t right! I don’t think you’re a tool at all! It’s not like that!
lines.zh: : 不管你看到了什么，都是错的！我根本不觉得你是工具！不是那样的！

lines.en: : Our entire relationship is built on you storming into my office and trying to sell me your virginity.
lines.zh: : 我们整段关系，都建立在某天你冲进我办公室、想把你的处女之身卖给我这件事上。

lines.en: scene kirinxmad21
: Who gives a shit about what it’s {i}built{/i} on?! That’s not what it is anymore!
lines.zh: : 谁他妈在乎它{i}建立{/i}在什么上面？！它早就不是那样了！

lines.en: : Tons of shit has happened since then and...now I...Sensei, I-
lines.zh: : 从那以后发生了太多事，而现在……Sensei，我——

lines.en: : Don’t say it...
lines.zh: : 别说……

lines.en: : Fuck you! I {i}want{/i} to feel this for once! You don’t get to take that from me!
lines.zh: : 去你的！我这一次{i}想要{/i}好好感受它！你没有资格把它从我身上夺走！

lines.en: : I’m tired of nothing ever being enough! And I’m tired of forcing myself to {i}not{/i} feel things! But if that’s going to make me end up like {i}you,{/i} fuck it! I’ll feel everything ever right fucking now!
lines.zh: : 我受够了什么永远都不够！我也受够了逼着自己{i}去压抑{/i}感受！可如果那样会让我变成{i}你{/i}这样，去他妈的！我现在他妈就要把一切感受个遍！

lines.en: : Don’t, Kirin...
lines.zh: : 别这样，Kirin……

lines.en: : I...{i}love{/i} you.
scene kirinxmad22
: I won’t regret anything about whatever this is...or whatever it winds up being.
lines.zh: : 不管这是什么……或者最后变成什么，我都不后悔。

lines.en: : If it’s just history when everything is said and done, then...fine. I’ll deal with that when it happens.
lines.zh: : 如果尘埃落定时它只是一段历史，那……也好。等真到那一步我再面对。

lines.en: : But that other thing you said...about not wanting something to pluck you from my hands?...
lines.zh: : 可你刚才说的另一件事……说什么不想有东西把你从我手里夺走？……

lines.en: : What the fuck, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 搞什么啊，Sensei？……

lines.en: : I’m supposed to be the one depriving myself of experiences and now {i}you{/i} want to do that {i}for{/i} me? Once I’m finally starting to accept that I {i}shouldn’t?{/i}
lines.zh: : 本来该是我自己剥夺自己的体验，现在{i}你{/i}倒想{i}替{/i}我做了？而且还是在我终于开始接受「{i}不该{/i}那样」的时候？

lines.en: : Maybe {i}I’m{/i} just the tool then? Maybe {i}I’m{/i} the one who-
lines.zh: : 那也许{i}我{/i}才是工具？也许{i}我{/i}才是那个——

lines.en: : I love you too.
lines.zh: : 我也爱你。

lines.en: scene kirinxmad23
: Why do you think I didn’t want you to say it?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我为什么不想让你说出口？

lines.en: : You...
: Maybe we {i}should{/i} run away?
lines.zh: : 也许我们{i}该{/i}私奔？

lines.en: : Because even if we’re forced back here in the end, it sounds like something that could be good for us.
lines.zh: : 因为就算最后我们被抓回来，这听起来也像是一件对我们有好处的事。

lines.en: : A way to...deceive ourselves into thinking we’re decent people when we’re really just two perpetual train wrecks.
lines.zh: : 一种……自我欺骗的方式，好让我们以为自己是正派人，尽管我们其实只是两场永不停止的灾难。

lines.en: : You...{i}love{/i} me?...
: I shouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 我不该。

lines.en: : But...you {i}do.{/i}
lines.zh: : 可……你{i}确实爱{/i}。

lines.en: : You’re not just saying that.
lines.zh: : 你不是随口说说。

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Okay...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Why what?
lines.zh: : 为什么什么？

lines.en: : Why do you love me? I’ve been terrible basically the entire time I’ve known you. Was starting to own up to that really all it took to-
lines.zh: : 你为什么爱我？我认识你以来基本上一直都很糟糕。难道光是开始承认这一点就够了——

lines.en: : I think I have for a while, if we’re being honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我想我爱了有一阵子了。

lines.en: : And you just...
lines.zh: : 而你就……

lines.en: : You just...kept that to yourself. Didn’t think it was at all relevant to {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你就……一直憋着。觉得这跟{i}我{/i}一点关系都没有。

lines.en: : I just want you to hate me.
lines.zh: : 我只想让你恨我。

lines.en: : I’m tired of falling, Kirin. I just want someone to put me out of my misery at this point.
lines.zh: : 我厌倦了坠落，Kirin。到了这一步，我只想有人来结束我的痛苦。

lines.en: : Let’s do it.
lines.zh: : 那就做吧。

lines.en: : Run away? Or put me out of my misery?
lines.zh: : 私奔？还是结束我的痛苦？

lines.en: : Neither. Let’s like, {i}literally{/i} do it. Because I’m feeling extremely emotional right now and I feel like the only way I can get better is by seeing what it feels like to “make love” instead of “fuck” for once.
lines.zh: : 都不是。我是说，{i}字面意义上{/i}的「做」。因为我现在情绪特别满，我觉得唯一能让我好起来的办法，就是体会一次「做爱」而不是「操」是什么感觉。

lines.en: : It’s more or less the same at the end of the day. The only thing that changes is the monologue.
lines.zh: : 说到底都差不多。唯一改变的是内心独白。

lines.en: : Is that why all I can hear inside of my head right now is screaming?
lines.zh: : 所以我现在脑子里全是尖叫声？

lines.en: : It’ll go away in time.
lines.zh: : 过一阵子就会消失的。

lines.en: : Are we doing it or not?
lines.zh: : 我们到底做不做？

lines.en: : We-
lines.zh: : 我们——

lines.en: : Trick question. The answer is yes.
lines.zh: : 这是陷阱题。答案是做。

lines.en: : Kirin-
lines.zh: : Kirin——

lines.en: : You can “Kirin” me all you want later.
lines.zh: : 你想怎么喊我「Kirin」都等会儿再说。

lines.en: scene black
: I want {i}this{/i} moment to be a good one for once...
lines.zh: : 我想让{i}这一刻{/i}，哪怕就一次，成为一个美好的时刻……

lines.en: scene kirinxmad24
She kisses differently when she’s happy.
lines.zh: 她开心的时候，接吻的方式不一样。

lines.en: Both times I’ve experienced it, she’s been wearing this dress.
lines.zh: 我体会过的两次，她都穿着这条裙子。

lines.en: Maybe it’s good luck. Or maybe it’s just something about the way it fits her that makes me want to chop her into pieces and box her up so she can stay by my side forever.
lines.zh: 也许是好运。又或者，只是它贴合她的方式让我恨不得把她剁成块装进箱子，好让她永远留在我身边。

lines.en: It’s hard to explain how I’m feeling right now. But it’s like that any time I fall for {i}anyone.{/i}
lines.zh: 我现在的感觉很难解释。不过我每次爱上{i}谁{/i}都是这样。

lines.en: Like Kirin, though, I’m tired.
lines.zh: 但跟 Kirin 一样，我累了。

lines.en: I’m tired of doubting myself when it comes to things like this. I’m tired of being one step away from “happy” just to lose my footing after pretending to see a copperhead.
lines.zh: 我厌倦了在这种事上怀疑自己。我厌倦了离「幸福」只有一步之遥，却因为假想看见一条铜头蛇而失足。

lines.en: By all rights, Kirin Kanda is a terrible person.
lines.zh: 按常理说，Kirin Kanda 是个糟糕透顶的人。

lines.en: By all wrongs, I have fallen for her.
lines.zh: 按所有的错理，我爱上了她。

lines.en: May the two of us be banished to hell — for it is the only place we’d be accepted.
lines.zh: 愿我们两个被放逐到地狱——因为那是唯一会接纳我们的地方。

lines.en: : Mmnh! Mm! Again...
lines.zh: : 嗯啊！嗯！再来……

lines.en: : I love you...
lines.zh: : 我爱你……

lines.en: : I love you! Mmnch! Sensei! I love you!
lines.zh: : 我爱你！呜嗯！Sensei！我爱你！

lines.en: : Mmh! Mnh! Again!
lines.zh: : 嗯！嗯啊！再来！

lines.en: : Kirin...
lines.zh: : Kirin……

lines.en: : {i}Again!{/i}
: {i}Ahem.{/i}
scene kirinxmad25
: Oh...shit.
: Hi?
: Oh, don’t mind me.
lines.zh: : 哦，别管我。

lines.en: : I’ll just {i}watch.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我就{i}看看{/i}。

lines.en: : Can you, like...not?
lines.zh: : 你能不能……别看？

lines.en: : Chika-
lines.zh: : Chika——

lines.en: scene kirinxmad26

: You know, I was {i}kinda{/i} worried that maybe Sensei had been lying to me about only fucking girls he loves when the two of you left the room together! But now I know he wasn’t! Further proof that I’m winning!
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，你们俩一起离开房间的时候，我还{i}挺{/i}担心 Sensei 对我撒了谎——他说自己只操他爱的女孩！但现在我知道他没有！这进一步证明我在赢！

lines.en: : W...Winning? What are you-
lines.zh: : 赢……赢？你在——

lines.en: : You should probably stop crying if you’re about to fuck, though. Sensei has this thing about not sticking it in girls with tears in their eyes and, while I get that sex is emotional and stuff, maaaaaaybe get over it?
lines.zh: : 不过你要是马上要做爱，最好先别哭了。Sensei 有个毛病，不插眼睛里含泪的女孩。虽然我理解做爱是很情绪化什么的，但也许你该克服一下？

lines.en: : How do you even-
lines.zh: : 你怎么会——

lines.en: scene kirinxmad27
: Because I’m your perfect girlfriend! How {i}else{/i} would I know something like that about you? Nothing gets past me! No-siree!
lines.zh: : 因为我是你的完美女朋友啊！{i}不然{/i}我怎么会知道你这种事？什么都逃不过我的眼睛！绝对不会！

lines.en: : Except the fact that all of the sexual experience Kirin has been touting has apparently been about you! Silly Chika! But if {i}you{/i} have found something to like about her, I’ll just have to believe it!
lines.zh: : 除了 Kirin 一直吹嘘的那些性经验，原来全是关于你的！笨死了我！不过既然{i}你{/i}发现了她身上值得喜欢的地方，那我也只能相信啦！

lines.en: : Maybe she’s super tight? Maybe she makes cute noises or something? I don’t know! Guess I’ll find out soon, though! Please continue!
lines.zh: : 也许她特别紧？也许她会发出很可爱的声音什么的？我不知道！不过我大概很快就会知道了！请继续！

lines.en: scene kirinxmad28
: Uhh...no thank you?
lines.zh: : 呃……谢了不用？

lines.en: : Under normal circumstances, I’d be, like...all for this. But this is {i}kind of{/i} a special moment that I don’t really want someone lurking in the corner for...
lines.zh: : 换作平时，我大概……完全没问题。可这是个{i}挺{/i}特别的时刻，我实在不希望有人在角落里盯着……

lines.en: : Sensei supports it, though! Don’t you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 可 Sensei 支持啊！对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: scene kirinxmad29
: Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: : I’m not going to be able to make her leave, Kirin...
lines.zh: : 我没法让她走，Kirin……

lines.en: : What the fuck even {i}is{/i} this?
lines.zh: : 这到底{i}算{/i}什么啊？

lines.en: : It’s...hard to explain.
lines.zh: : 这……很难解释。

lines.en: : Not really!
lines.zh: : 一点都不难！

lines.en: scene kirinxmad27
: Sensei is my boyfriend! But he has an interesting, super-awesome take on love that allows him to “love” a whole bunch of people at one time! And {i}you{/i} are one of those people!
lines.zh: : Sensei 是我的男朋友！不过他对爱有一套有趣又超棒的理解，让他可以同时「爱」一大堆人！而{i}你{/i}就是其中之一！

lines.en: : We made an agreement where he still gets to fuck them and stuff. But since I’m his {i}actual{/i} love, I should probably be able to watch. Or join in! Just to make sure you’re doing everything correctly.
lines.zh: : 我们约定好了，他照样可以操她们什么的。不过既然我才是他{i}真正的{/i}爱人，我大概应该有权旁观。或者加入！就为了确保你们做得都对。

lines.en: : You’re still totally special, though! So if you’re currently beating yourself up about how this doesn’t make you unique or that it isn’t “true love” or whatever, just stop. That’s, like...so immature. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 不过你依然完全特别！所以如果你现在正为了「这样就不独特了」「这不是真爱」之类的事钻牛角尖，赶紧停下。那真的……太幼稚了。对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: scene kirinxmad30
: What the fuck is she going on about?...
lines.zh: : 她到底在胡扯什么？……

lines.en: : {b}SPORK.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}SPORK.{/b}

lines.en: : Kirin...
lines.zh: : Kirin……

lines.en: : Maybe we should pick this back up after the Christmas party?
lines.zh: : 也许等圣诞派对结束我们再继续？
